items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I made some arrangements for him

ctx.x: You know, there's a guy in New York City was living on Park Avenue, and he used to come down to Roseland in New York City and listen to Fletcher and that great band, and he told Fletcher one day that he would like to go down in history and have a great jazz band for a change, you

know, and he talked with Fletcher and he talked with me, and he said, 'Your brother here, I understand, is an arranger and whatnot.' He said -- he didn't ask Fletcher about writing, but I guess he figured Fletcher was committed, (unintelligible), you know. And he said, 'How about you doing something for me?' I made some arrangements for him and didn't even have his band in mind, you know. I just wrote something. And he said what his instrumentation would be -- and he said he wanted me to write him some jazz…
